farm: 台電台中港風力發電站 11 號機 — 2019-12-06

sources.quote: 台電發言人徐造華表示，台電內部正在進行事故調查，當時瞬間風速為每秒 30 公尺，依風機監控信號紀錄判斷，風機可能因迎風轉向系統異常，造成機艙角度偏移，讓 3 支葉片不敵陣風斷裂。 至於損失金額，徐造華表示，風機已發電超過 13 年，屬於台灣第一期風機，初估損失約 1 千萬元。
位於台中港區，環港北路上，台電的第11號風機，6日發生葉片斷裂。工人在11號風機旁的空地，準備吊起斷裂葉片的殘骸。 台電表示，目前在高美溼地附近的風機有14部，葉片斷裂當天，當地瞬間風速達每秒30公尺，還在風機可耐風速每秒42.2公尺範圍內。研判是該座風機「迎風轉向系統」異常造成。

data.project_en: Taipower Taichung Port wind power station
data.title_zh: 強風中 11 號風機迎風轉向系統異常，3 支葉片斷裂
data.title_en: Yaw system fault in strong wind breaks all three blades of turbine 11
data.summary_zh: 12 月 6 日上午台中港環港北路的台電第 11 號風機 3 支葉片斷裂，當時瞬間風速每秒 30 公尺、未超過機組可耐的 42.2 m/s；台電依監控信號研判迎風轉向系統異常使機艙角度偏移、轉子超速，初估損失約新台幣 1 千萬元，同址 14 部機組停機檢查後 13 部於 10 日復轉（中央社／公視，2019-12-11）。
data.summary_en: On the morning of 6 December the three blades of Taipower's turbine 11 on Huangang North Road at Taichung Port broke in a 30 m/s gust, below the machine's 42.2 m/s rating; from the monitoring signals Taipower judged that a yaw-system fault had shifted the nacelle and let the rotor overspeed, put the loss at about NT$10 million and restarted the other 13 of the 14 turbines on 10 December after checks (CNA / PTS, 11 Dec 2019).
data.cap_note_zh: 台中港風場 2007 年商轉；受損機組為台電第一期、IEC Class IIB 舊機型
data.cod: 2006 年前後（台電稱已運轉 13 年）
data.coord_note_zh: 風場層 Taichung Port 參考點，非事故機位
data.org: 中央社（經科技新報轉載）／公視新聞網
data.verify_zh: 媒體報導核對（出處原文已以 check_quotes 核對）
data.note_zh: 與 2008、2015、2016 年颱風事件不同，本次無颱風；台電稱屬設備異常個案、將修改運轉 SOP。最終調查報告未見公開。 風場層紀錄：Zephyros Z72 2.0 MW×13＋Enercon E-82 3.0 MW×3；11 號機機型報導未寫。
data.note_en: Unlike the 2008, 2015 and 2016 typhoon events there was no typhoon; Taipower called it an isolated equipment fault and said it would revise its operating procedures. No final investigation report was found. Farm record: 13 × Zephyros Z72 2.0 MW + 3 × Enercon E-82 3.0 MW; the reports do not say which model unit 11 is.

farm: 大彰化西北 Changhua 4 葉片損毀 — 2026-10-02

sources.quote: 大彰化西北離岸風場一座風機2日中午發生葉片損毀。沃旭能源今天說明，確認無人傷亡，附近海域亦已採取安全管制，後續風機系統原廠西門子歌美颯將主導並負責事件調查。 沃旭能源今天發布新聞稿證實，大彰化西北離岸風場單一風機葉片損毀，事件發生當時風機並無人員作業，安全區域內亦無船舶，可以確認無人傷亡。

data.title_en: Blade damaged on one turbine a month after full operation; exclusion zone at sea
data.summary_zh: 10 月 2 日中午大彰化西北離岸風場一部風機葉片損毀；沃旭能源說事發時風機無人作業、安全區域內無船舶，確認無人傷亡，附近海域已採安全管制並通報中央與地方主管機關，工作船待命，全場風機仍在西門子歌美颯保固期內、由其主導調查（中央社，2026-10-03）。
data.summary_en: At noon on 2 October a blade on one turbine of the Greater Changhua Northwest (Changhua 4) offshore wind farm was damaged; Ørsted said no one was working on the turbine and no vessel was inside the safety zone, confirmed no casualties, set up a maritime exclusion zone, notified the central and local authorities and kept a work vessel on standby; all turbines are still under Siemens Gamesa warranty and SGRE leads the investigation (CNA, 3 Oct 2026).

farm: 新屋浜風力発電所（秋田市新屋海浜公園）葉片落下 — 2025-05-02

sources.quote: An 81-year-old man has died in the northern Japanese prefecture of Akita after a 40-metre-long wind turbine blade broke and fell to the ground.
秋田市新屋町の新屋海浜公園で昨年５月に風力発電用風車のブレード（羽根）が落下した事故について、事故調査委員会は２１日、過去の落雷が原因で羽根の補強板が損傷したことが原因と考えられると公表した。経済産業省が事故原因の究明のために開いた審議会で示した。事故が発生した新屋浜風力発電所（１基）は準備が整い次第設備を撤去し廃止される。
而日本秋田縣2日發生風機的螺旋漿掉落，疑似因此砸中一名老翁，陸域風機的維護安全，再度引發關注。

data.title_zh: 約 40 m 葉片根部折斷落地，81 歲男子倒臥葉片旁身亡
data.title_en: 40 m blade snaps at the root and falls; 81-year-old man found dead beside it
data.summary_zh: 5 月 2 日上午秋田市新屋海浜公園一部 Enercon E-82 風機約 40 m 長的葉片自根部折斷落地，一名 81 歲男子被發現倒臥在葉片旁、送醫不治，死亡與落下葉片的因果關係由縣警調查（RenewEconomy，2025-05-14）；2026-01-21 經產省審議會上事故調查委員會認定：過去落雷造成放電使葉片補強板受損，長期運轉後損傷擴大、強度下降，在放電位置附近折斷，該風機將拆除廢止（秋田魁新報，2026-01-22）。
data.summary_en: On the morning of 2 May a roughly 40 m blade of the Enercon E-82 turbine at Araya Seaside Park in Akita City snapped at the root and fell; an 81-year-old man was found lying beside it and died in hospital, and the prefectural police examined the link between the blade and his death (RenewEconomy, 14 May 2025). At METI's panel on 21 Jan 2026 the investigation committee concluded that an earlier lightning strike had damaged a reinforcing plate inside the blade, the damage grew during long operation until the blade broke near the discharge point; the turbine is to be removed and the station closed (Akita Sakigake Shimpo, 22 Jan 2026).

data.note_en: The deaths field is left blank: on 15 Apr 2026 the Sakigake still wrote that the causal link between the blade fall and the man's death had not been established. Enercon brought forward blade inspections of E-82 turbines in Japan after the event. Unit capacity to be verified.

farm: 風の王国・男鹿（男鹿市船越）葉片折損 — 2026-04-12

sources.quote: 風車を設置する「風の王国・男鹿」（同市）によると、３月２０日にレセプター（避雷針）以外の部分に落雷を受けて羽根が損傷。約１カ月間そのまま運用されたことで損傷が拡大して強度が下がり、４月１２日に折れた。 風車は一定より大きな落雷を受けたときに自動停止する設定だったが、３月２０日はこの設定より小さな落雷だったため停止しなかった。４月４日には月例の点検が行われたが、動いている羽根を目視で確認する方法だったため損傷を見落とした。
今度は男鹿市船越で風車の羽根１枚が根元から折れた。羽根は全長約４０メートル。けが人は確認されていないが、すぐそばに男鹿総合観光案内所がある。

data.title_zh: 落雷受損未被察覺、續運一個月後葉片根部折斷
data.title_en: Blade snaps at the root a month after an undetected lightning strike
data.summary_zh: 4 月 12 日男鹿市船越一部風機全長約 40 m 的葉片自根部折斷，未有人受傷，旁邊即為男鹿綜合觀光案內所（秋田魁新報，2026-04-15）；設置者「風の王国・男鹿」說明 3 月 20 日葉片在避雷接收器以外部位遭落雷受損，因雷擊小於自動停機門檻未停機，4 月 4 日月檢只以目視檢查轉動中的葉片而漏看，續運約一個月後損傷擴大折斷；經產省 9 月 25 日審議會決定要求設置者提出再發防止策（秋田魁新報，2026-09-25）。
data.summary_en: On 12 April a roughly 40 m blade of a turbine at Funakoshi in Oga City broke at the root; nobody was hurt, though the Oga tourist information centre stands right beside it (Akita Sakigake Shimpo, 15 Apr 2026). The owner, Kaze no Okoku Oga, explained that lightning had hit the blade outside its receptor on 20 March, too small a strike to trigger the automatic stop, the monthly inspection on 4 April only looked at the rotating blades by eye and missed the damage, and after about a month of continued operation the weakened blade broke; METI's panel on 25 September decided to ask the owner for recurrence-prevention measures (Sakigake, 25 Sep 2026).
data.cas_zh: 秋田魁新報：未確認有人受傷

data.note_en: The second blade failure in Akita within a year of the Araya event of 2 May 2025. Turbine model, capacity and the formal station name are still to be verified (the Sakigake articles are paywalled; only the visible part is quoted).

farm: 昆布盛ウインドファーム 6 號機機艙火災 — 2019-04-08

sources.quote: 平成31年4月8日に北海道根室市内で発生した風力発電設備の風車軸受損壊に伴うナセル火災事故について、 令和元年11月19日に開催された第20回新エネルギー発電設備事故対応・構造強度ワーキンググループにおける原因究明及び再発防止策の検討結果を踏まえ、以下のとおり求める。 当該事故は、電気事業法で定めた法令点検が適切に行われなかったことで、主軸受破損、主軸のずれ、ナセル火災に至った事例である。

data.project_zh: 昆布盛ウインドファーム（昆布盛風場）
data.title_zh: 主軸承破損引發機艙火災，經產省認定法定點檢未落實
data.title_en: Main-bearing failure leads to nacelle fire; METI finds statutory inspections were not carried out properly
data.summary_zh: 4 月 8 日根室市昆布盛風場 6 號機因風車軸承損壞引發機艙火災；經產省新能源發電設備事故對應工作小組 2019-11-19 審議後，2020-02-17 向全國設置者發出要求：本案是電氣事業法規定的法定點檢未適當執行、導致主軸承破損、主軸偏移而至機艙火災，僅靠溫度感測器監視無法掌握軸承損傷，應以年度點檢確認潤滑脂狀態（經濟產業省，2020-02-17）。
data.summary_en: On 8 April the nacelle of turbine 6 at the Konbumori Wind Farm in Nemuro caught fire after its main bearing failed; after METI's working group on new-energy generation accidents reviewed the case on 19 Nov 2019, METI issued a request to all owners on 17 Feb 2020 stating that the statutory inspections under the Electricity Business Act had not been carried out properly, which led to the bearing failure, shaft displacement and nacelle fire, that temperature sensors alone had not revealed the bearing damage, and that grease condition should be checked at annual inspections (METI, 17 Feb 2020).

data.title_en: Tower buckles at about 37 m and collapses in Typhoon Jebi
data.summary_zh: 9 月 4 日颱風 21 號（燕子）通過時，和歌山縣日高郡的日の岬ウインドパーク風機塔架在中段約 37 m 處向西北座屈，葉片連著機艙落地；當日 10 時 30 分前後地區停電使 SCADA 停止記錄，業者アドエコロジー 2019-09-27 的報告以颱風模型推估輪轂高度最大 10 分平均風速 52.2 m/s、超過設計值 42.5 m/s，並列出停電後偏航無法控制為因素之一（經濟產業省工作小組資料，2019-09-27）；經產省 2020-02-17 就白馬與日の岬兩案向全國設置者發出要求（經濟產業省，2020-02-17）。
data.summary_en: On 4 September, as Typhoon Jebi (No. 21) passed, the turbine of the Hinomisaki Wind Park in Hidaka District, Wakayama, buckled north-westwards at about 37 m up the tower and the blades fell to the ground still attached to the nacelle; a local blackout at about 10:30 stopped the SCADA recording, and the owner Ad Ecology's report of 27 Sep 2019 estimated with a typhoon model a maximum 10-minute hub-height wind of 52.2 m/s, above the 42.5 m/s design value, listing the loss of yaw control after the blackout among the factors (METI working-group material, 27 Sep 2019); on 17 Feb 2020 METI issued a request to all owners over the Shirama and Hinomisaki cases (METI, 17 Feb 2020).

sources.quote: 지난해 10월 제주 행원풍력단지에서는 대형 화재사고가 발생했다. 당시 발전기에 불이 붙은 상태에서 6시간 동안 블레이드(날개)가 계속 회전해 결국 주탑이 붕괴되며 발전기 전체가 주저앉았다. 이같이 대형 화재사고로 번진 것은 화재 발생시 풍력발전기의 회전을 제어하는 기능이 없었기 때문이다.
한편 도내에선 2010년 제주시 구좌읍 행원풍력발전단지를 시작으로 그동안 4차례나 풍력발전기 화재가 발생했다.

data.title_en: Burning turbine keeps spinning for six hours until the tower collapses
data.summary_zh: 2010 年 10 月濟州道經營的杏源風場一部風機發生大火，起火後葉片仍持續旋轉 6 小時，最後主塔崩塌、整部風機倒下；週刊京鄉引國會議員質詢指出，釀成大火是因為機組沒有火災時控制旋轉的功能（週刊京鄉，2011-04-27）；Financial News 2020 年報導稱濟州自 2010 年杏源風場起已發生 4 次風機火災（파이낸셜뉴스，2020-11-08）。
data.summary_en: In October 2010 a turbine at the Jeju-government-run Haengwon wind farm caught fire; the blades kept turning for six hours while it burned until the tower collapsed and the whole machine came down. The Weekly Kyunghyang, citing a National Assembly member, said the fire grew because the turbine had no function to stop the rotor during a fire (Weekly Kyunghyang, 27 Apr 2011); Financial News reported in 2020 that Jeju had seen four turbine fires since the 2010 Haengwon fire (Financial News, 8 Nov 2020).

data.summary_zh: 11 月 8 日凌晨 3 時 58 分左右濟州市翰京面頭毛浦口前的離岸風機起火，海警出動救助艇與警備艦但因風機高 78 m 無法滅火，天亮後濟州消防安全本部與山林廳直升機投入，7 時 25 分完全撲滅；該風場為耽羅海上風力營運的韓國首座商業離岸風場，3 MW×10 部共 30 MW，2017 年 9 月起發電，警消向業者調查起火原因（파이낸셜뉴스，2020-11-08）。
data.summary_en: At about 03:58 on 8 November an offshore turbine off Dumo harbour in Hangyeong-myeon, Jeju, caught fire; the coast guard sent a rescue boat and a patrol vessel but could not reach the flames on the 78 m machine, and after daybreak fire-service and Forest Service helicopters put the fire out by 07:25. The farm, run by Tamra Offshore Wind Power, is Korea's first commercial offshore wind farm, 10 × 3 MW = 30 MW, generating since September 2017; police and fire authorities were investigating the cause with the operator (Financial News, 8 Nov 2020).

data.summary_zh: 2 月 10 日上午 8 時 37 分梁山市魚谷洞伊甸谷附近山上的風機起火，風場員工與附近寺院人員等 6 人自行避難、無人傷亡，風機一部分與塔下雜木燒毀、無停電等二次災害；因高處冒煙民眾報案 86 件，消防與山火撲滅隊投入 82 人、23 台裝備與 7 架直升機，約 2 小時後 10 時 31 分控制主要火勢，警消將調查起火原因（트윅／이투데이，2026-02-10）。
data.summary_en: At 08:37 on 10 February a wind turbine on a hill near Eden Valley in Eogok-dong, Yangsan, caught fire; six people, including wind-farm staff and people from a nearby temple, evacuated on their own and nobody was hurt, part of the turbine and the scrub below it burned, and there was no secondary damage such as a blackout. Smoke from the high ground brought 86 emergency calls; fire crews and forest-fire teams with 82 people, 23 vehicles and seven helicopters had the main fire under control by 10:31, about two hours later, and police and fire authorities were to investigate the cause (Twig / eToday, 10 Feb 2026).

data.title_en: 3.3 MW turbine collapses in a rainy night less than three months after full grid connection
data.summary_zh: 4 月 11 日深夜內黃縣馬上鄉風雨中一部約 140 m 高的風機塔筒向西傾倒在田裡，折斷處離地約 30 m，塔身印有「華潤電力」字樣、未砸到人；該項目 9 部機組（8×3.3 MW＋1×3.6 MW）2022-01-21 全容量併網，涉事機型 3.3MW-164、葉輪直徑 164 m，約 2021-11 安裝完成（今日頭條轉載上游新聞等，2022-04-14）；中國能源報 4 月 25 日報導稱事故具體原因暫無官方通報（人民網《中國能源報》，2022-04-25）。
data.summary_en: Late on 11 April, in wind and rain, a roughly 140 m turbine tower in Mashang Township, Neihuang County, toppled westwards into a field, breaking about 30 m above the ground; the tower bore the China Resources Power logo and nobody was hit. The project's nine turbines (8 × 3.3 MW + 1 × 3.6 MW) had reached full grid connection on 21 Jan 2022; the failed unit was a 3.3 MW machine with a 164 m rotor installed around November 2021 (Toutiao, reposting Shangyou News and others, 14 Apr 2022). China Energy News reported on 25 April that no official statement on the cause had been issued (People's Daily Online / China Energy News, 25 Apr 2022).

The owner, Hacom Bac Lieu Energy, reported to the province and set up a team to establish the cause and losses, and district leaders inspected the site on 2 March (Bao Phap luat, 2 Mar 2024; VOV, 1 Mar 2024). Phase 1 is 80 MW, inaugurated on 29 Apr 2022.

data.title_zh: 新裝 V150 風機 73 m 葉片自輪轂脫落
data.title_en: 73 m blade separates from the hub of a newly installed V150 turbine
data.summary_zh: 10 月 5 日（星期一）晚上 7 時 30 分左右，試運轉中的 336 MW Dundonnell 風場一部運轉中的 Vestas V150-4.2 MW 風機 73 m 長、約 15 t 的葉片自 115 m 高的輪轂脫落墜地，全場 80 部機組停機；業主 Tilt Renewables 聲明無人受傷、其他財產與風機無損，將與 Vestas 做根因分析（RenewEconomy，2020-10-07）。後續報導指葉片與輪轂的螺栓鬆脫。
data.summary_en: At about 19:30 on Monday 5 October a 73 m, roughly 15 t blade of an operating Vestas V150-4.2 MW turbine at the 336 MW Dundonnell wind farm, then in commissioning, separated from the hub at about 115 m and fell to the ground, halting all 80 turbines; owner Tilt Renewables said there were no injuries and no damage to other property or turbines and that a root-cause analysis would be done with Vestas (RenewEconomy, 7 Oct 2020). Later reports attributed the fall to loosened blade-to-hub bolts.
data.coord_note_zh: 風場層 Dundonnell 參考點，非事故機位
data.verify_zh: 媒體報導核對（出處原文已以 check_quotes 核對）
data.note_zh: 螺栓鬆脫為後續報導的說法，為何鬆脫仍在調查，不填入根因欄。
data.note_en: Loose bolts is the later press account; why they loosened was still under investigation, so it is not entered as the root cause.

farm: Tararua Wind Farm 風機火災 — 2021-10-06

data.area_zh: 北島 Tararua 山脈（Palmerston North 附近）
data.area_en: Tararua Ranges near Palmerston North, North Island
data.title_zh: 134 部機組之一起火，相連 5 部停機
data.title_en: One of 134 turbines catches fire; five connected turbines taken offline
data.summary_zh: 10 月 6 日（星期三）161 MW Tararua 風場 134 部 Vestas 機組之一起火，消防控制後火勢侷限於該機；業主 Mercury 說起火時無人在附近、損壞限於一部，相連的 5 部一併停機，運維承包商 Vestas 將全面檢討（RenewEconomy，2021-10-07）。
data.summary_en: On Wednesday 6 October one of the 134 Vestas turbines at the 161 MW Tararua wind farm caught fire; emergency services brought it under control and it stayed within the one machine. Owner Mercury said nobody was near the turbine when it started, damage was limited to that unit, five connected turbines were taken out of service and O&M contractor Vestas would carry out a full review (RenewEconomy, 7 Oct 2021).
data.cap_note_zh: 三期合計 161 MW、134 部機組
data.cas_zh: Mercury：起火時無人在附近；報導未提傷亡
data.cas_en: Mercury: nobody near the fire when it started; no casualties reported
data.coord_note_zh: 風場層 Tararua wind farm 參考點，非事故機位
data.verify_zh: 媒體報導核對（出處原文已以 check_quotes 核對）
data.note_zh: 日期依報導「星期三」（刊出 2021-10-07 星期四）。起火機組屬哪一期與機型未確定；原因未見公開。
data.note_en: Date from "on Wednesday" in the report (published Thursday 7 Oct 2021). Which stage and model the burnt turbine belonged to is not established; no cause published.

sources.quote: One of the 62 wind turbines at our West Wind Farm in Makara, Wellington has suffered major blade failure. We are currently investigating the cause of the failure. There was no one working in the vicinity of the turbine when the failure occurred. The remainder of the turbines at West Wind continue to operate normally. West Wind has 62 2.3MW Siemens turbines.

data.title_zh: 62 部 Siemens 2.3 MW 機組之一葉片嚴重斷裂
data.title_en: Major blade failure on one of 62 Siemens 2.3 MW turbines
data.summary_zh: Meridian Energy 10 月 19 日公告威靈頓 Makara 的 West Wind 風場 62 部 Siemens 2.3 MW 機組之一葉片嚴重斷裂，事發時附近無人作業，其餘機組正常運轉，原因調查中（Meridian Energy，2021-10-19）。
data.summary_en: Meridian Energy announced on 19 October that one of the 62 Siemens 2.3 MW turbines at its West Wind farm in Makara, Wellington, had suffered a major blade failure; nobody was working near the turbine at the time, the other turbines kept operating and the cause was being investigated (Meridian Energy, 19 Oct 2021).
data.cas_zh: 業主：事發時附近無人作業
data.cas_en: owner: nobody working nearby when it happened
data.coord_note_zh: 風場層 West Wind wind farm 參考點，非事故機位
data.verify_zh: 主管機關／業主一手資料
data.note_zh: 日期為業主公告日；事發確切日未寫。與同月 Tararua 火災是不同風場、不同業主。
data.note_en: Date is the owner's announcement date; the exact day of failure is not given. Unrelated to the Tararua fire the same month (different farm and owner).
